finding.statement: A retained evidence writer must reject a pre-positioned symbolic-link output and leave the link target unchanged; path-level no-overwrite claims require an adversarial symlink fixture, not only a conventional existing-file case.
finding.uncertainty: The committed fixture has not yet been observed in an authenticated GitHub Actions or local Node test run through the available connector.

primary_sources.title: Node.js File system documentation
primary_sources.relevance: Documents file-system write flags and exclusive creation semantics used by fsPromises.writeFile.

primary_sources.title: Linux open(2) manual page
primary_sources.relevance: Defines O_CREAT with O_EXCL behavior, including failure when the path names a symbolic link.

implementation.test: exclusive manifest creation rejects a pre-positioned symbolic-link output without altering its target

verification.claim_boundary: The commit proves the fixture exists. It does not prove the fixture passed on GitHub Actions, macOS, Windows, or a production host.

falsification_routes: Run node --test operations/tests/write-bound-vercel-authenticated-evidence-manifest.test.mjs in an authenticated checkout and retain stdout, exit status, Node version, OS, and exact commit SHA.
Replace the exclusive-create flag with a nonexclusive write in a controlled branch; the fixture should fail by observing mutation of the protected target.
Execute the fixture on supported non-Linux platforms and record platform-specific symlink behavior rather than generalizing the Linux result.
design_implication: Keep retained evidence outputs append-only and exclusive-create. Treat symlink pre-positioning as a first-class adversarial no-overwrite case in the evidence pipeline.
